rows.behavior: Opt-in native builder command: explicit worktree root, mode conflicts, agy-only, builder role only

claims.claim: --build runs an agy family as a native builder in the Git worktree root named by --cwd, with no deny list
--build requires an explicit --cwd
--cwd must be the canonical Git worktree root; filesystem root, home and a folder holding it are refused
a --cwd that is not its own git rev-parse --show-toplevel is refused
the root check runs before the version probe
the family or --role builder must resolve to agy; another vendor exits 64
--role other than builder is refused with --build
--build cannot combine with --investigate, --no-tools, --min-tools, --x-search or --schema
ask-model runs the one named family or the builder role's resolved family

rows.behavior: Native agy invocation: accept-edits, normal HOME and permissions, finite timeout, prompt prefix, no other safeguards

claims.claim: agy runs with --mode accept-edits, the model, effort, stream-json and a print timeout
the print timeout is finite (1800s)
the build uses the process env plus AGY_ENV, not the wall's TMPDIR, and no sandbox-exec
the build runs the CLI directly (no sandbox-exec wrapper) as a native build
the build branch makes no workspace, ~/.gemini/config or wall check, which the read-only branch does
the read-only branch makes the workspace, config and wall checks
the prompt is prefixed with instructions not to call other models, run reviews or grades, push, open a PR or merge

rows.behavior: Pinned CLI version and plaintext-token checks before and after the version probe and after the call

claims.claim: agy --version must equal AGY_VERSION or the build does not start
the plaintext token file is checked before the version probe
the plaintext token file is checked again after the version probe
the token file lives at ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/antigravity-oauth-token
after the call a token file left behind fails the build
the per-call log must be a readable regular file owned by the user, opened without following links
a log that records file-based token storage fails the build
the postflight runs on every path after the CLI returns, including failure and cancellation, and a sign-in problem exits 4
the private per-call log directory is removed after the call
read-only calls keep their agy log under ~/.agent-config-studio/logs/agy/

rows.behavior: Native cancellation, failure and partial edits

claims.claim: INT, TERM and HUP to ask-model are remembered and sent to agy's process group, with a SIGKILL escalation
a cancelled call exits 4 with an error and no completion claim even if agy exits 0
edits may remain after errors and the worktree must be inspected before retrying; nothing is rolled back

rows.behavior: Success result: native completion, unverified model, no published claim, changed null, bounded diagnostics

claims.claim: success carries build.execution native and build.completed true
served.verified is false and the model is only what was requested
no build.published or brokerEvents field is set
changed stays null; the build path never snapshots the worktree
actions, denied and notes come from bounded parsing of agy's stream
a different model echoed by agy fails with exit 2
agy reports only the model it was asked for, so identity is unverified
the success path prints exit 0 only after the postflight and answer checks pass

rows.behavior: Default read-only agy behavior retained alongside --build

claims.claim: without --build agy keeps its read-only deny list
without --build agy runs in the sandbox-exec wall

rows.behavior: Benchmark: native Neon builder availability and accepted completion

claims.claim: Neon builds only when agy is on PATH, /usr/bin/sandbox-exec exists on macOS and ask-model advertises --build
the runner calls ask-model --build in the case repository
a result is accepted only with mode build, the matching id, served.verified false, execution native, completed true and no published key
a non-zero exit, a timeout or a missing completion claim stops the family without grading
the stop is returned for agy before any grade runs
the recorded build keeps only execution and completed
agy builds are wired through agyBuilderCall only when agyBuilder is set
setup and dry-run text describe ask-model --build with an unverified model and a sandboxed final grade
neon's read-only answer and judge calls still depend on ask-model's config check; the build route does not make it

rows.behavior: Benchmark: the final grader stays confined and independent

claims.claim: the Neon grade preflight and final grade run under sandbox-exec with confinedGrade
the final grade command runs in the confined invocation for Neon
the Neon grade is prepared for the agy family and for reference checks
reference grade tests are copied in from refSha before the grade

rows.behavior: No Neon quality score is claimed
rows.none: a statement of absence; neither the wrapper nor the runner computes a Neon quality score, so there is no code line to cite
